concept.title: Home
concept.shortdesc: The workspace's Home, at the top of the rail, gathers what needs you across every project. A project's own Home is the right-hand side of its Overview (on a phone, its top): the project's figures as four tiles, Needs you and Recent activity. The old Summary address opens the Overview.

conbody.p: Needs you lists what waits on the team. Click a line to open the artifact it names; the button on the right says what it does. Review all in its header opens the Review Queue.

ul.li: approve: an artifact in review; Review opens it.
suspect: a link whose ends changed after it was made. Still valid confirms the link still holds and Remove deletes it, after you confirm, right there on the line; the line leaves the list.
test run: a run still in progress, with how many test cases are left.
failing: a test case whose last result is a fail, and the requirements it verifies.

comment: a comment on an artifact that you have not read, by someone other than you; Open opens the artifact with its notes showing, which marks them read. Mark read clears the artifact's comments from the list without opening it, Mark all read in the header clears them all, and Undo on the line they leave puts them back.
proposal: a change an agent has proposed; Review opens the agent runs, where you approve or reject it.

conbody.p: Recent activity shows the newest events of the project, who did what to which artifact; click one to open what it is about. Full history opens the Activity page.
